title: disposable rounded chopsticks
text: disposable rounded chopsticks. These are a BIG step up from the "break away" chop stick...  They are narrow... and rounded.  But the tips are tapered.  They have a bit of a chemical smell.. so I had to knock off a star for that.  I am laying them out in the sun to see that removes some of the odor... I haven't noticed it as I am using them. Will update if new info seems useful.

product_metadata.title: CiboWares 9 Inch Disposable Bamboo Chopsticks, Pack of 100
